subject: Referred by [SENDER] Baish — EO/IR training data for [COMPANY]
text:
Hello,

I spoke with [SENDER] Baish earlier today and he suggested I send this
through to the right desk.

Encord is the data layer underneath EO/IR tracking and classification
models: curation, annotation, and evaluation. We recently completed a piece
of work with Forterra on their perception stack, which is how Chess
Dynamics came onto our radar. [SENDER] confirmed your We sit underneath EO/IR
tracking and classification models, doing the curation, annotation, and
evaluation. We worked with Forterra recently on their perception data, and
that's where the overlap with what you're building at [COMPANY] stood
out: in-house object detection and classification on small aerial and land
targets.

Two pages that i thought were relevant: Drones and aerial systems
<[LINK]>
 & Defense AI

<[LINK]>The
two questions we normally get asked are:
Can Encord be deployed fully on-premise?
Yes. The full platform runs inside your own infrastructure, including
air-gapped. No data touches Encord servers.

How does Encord handle export control (ITAR / EAR)?
The on-premise and VPC options are built for export-controlled
environments. Your data stays in your infrastructure with access controls
and audit logs, and we provide a security documentation package for your
legal and compliance teams to review.

If there's a relevant person on the imaging or machine learning side, I'd
value a short introduction. Happy to run a 20-minute session showing how
the Forterra workflow operates, no commitment expected.

subject: Autonomy/Intelligence stack for Traystar <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],
Congrats on the raise. I lead GTM efforts for the Physical AI segment at
Encord, previously having invested as a VC in the space for a number of
years.

I imagine you're early in building the team and underground systems, but
there are a number of visual understanding and intelligence use cases that
I expect you'll be training models against.  We're already working with
some of the top builders in robotics, AVs, drones, and other forms of
embodied intelligence to help develop their data pipelines against model
training.  1X, Bedrock Robotics, Scout AI, Boston Dynamics, etc all chose
to work with Encord as we have the most sophisticated Physical AI suite and
can help automate a large portion of the work that slows researchers down.

Time for a quick call in the next week or two?  Even if too early, it would
be good to give you a sense of when to start prioritizing the annotation
process in your development stack.

Let me know and I can share a few times.
